card.name: Mid-sentence in social and environmental essays
card.fires_on: Connecting or joining words and numbers in general-interest web prose about economics, environment or society, at the point where a cause, amount or consequence is about to be stated.

modes.label: Cause and link words
modes.description: Words like because, without, and, of or a comma that lead into a cause or consequence clause.
modes.example: or an employee taking home lower wages<< because>> higher health insurance premiums are deducted from his

modes.label: Figures and rates
modes.description: A dollar sign, space or per right before a quantity or rate.
modes.example: the cost for those same items in 2003 was<< $>>182.35. In

card.writes: Weak and mixed; it slightly suppresses words about globalization and society, mostly in Chinese and English, so there is little clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words and number lead-ins in essays about money, waste and society.
